engine.add_case_fact('kb', ('is_smart', 'Harry', True))

    ('is_green', '?x', True),
    (),
    ('is_furry', '?x', True))

    ('is_furry', 'Gary', True),
    (('is_smart', 'Gary', False),),
    ('is_white', 'Gary', True))

    ('is_smart', '?x', True),
    (),
    ('is_green', '?x', True))

    (('is_green', 'Bob', False),),
    (('is_white', 'Bob', False),),
    ('is_furry', 'Bob', True))

# Big people are cold.

    ('is_big', '?x', True),
    (),
    ('is_cold', '?x', True))

    ('is_big', '?x', True))

    ('is_white', '?x', True),
    (('is_cold', '?x', False),),
    ('is_blue', '?x', False))

    ('is_cold', '?x', True),
    (),
    ('is_blue', '?x', False))
